state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stages 2 to 5 are on disk: comparison, hashing, placeholders, the palette, QR codes and text. Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is partly on disk.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No session re-decides one.

Stage 6 on disk: the three enums (`HashKind`, `PlaceholderKind`, `QrLevel`) owe nothing, so check `dossier-novis-image-analysis-enums` passes. `Image::hashDistance` owes nothing: description, three examples, an attack, a bench measured in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`. Every one of the nine members now has its Rust test: `// covers:` markers in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs`, and `crates/nvs-cli/tests/image_analysis.rs` runs `hashDistance` and `Font::fromBytes` through the binary. The other eight members each still owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench (then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<member>'`, which the gate reads as "perf: never measured" until it runs).

Open question for the text members: an example needs a font as bytes, and the examples tree wants one self-contained file. The candidate is a font file in a subdirectory of the example's own folder (docs/examples/README.md § companions say a subdirectory is not counted as an example), read with a file-reading `Core` member. Not checked: which member reads a file, whether it needs a grant, and what the working directory is when `bun nv proofs --verify` runs an example. The fixture is `extensions/image/fixtures/DancingScript-Regular.ttf` (OFL, keep its licence beside any copy).

`cargo deny check bans` fails on a `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency that was already there before this goal; `cargo deny check licenses` was not re-run for `ab_glyph` and its three crates (not checked).

items.text: **The analysis members' proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — `Image::hash`, `Image::placeholder`, `Image::palette` and `Image::compare` at `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:326`: `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each, then `--record-perf`. A 4x4 grey pattern resized to 64x64 (see `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-HashKind/01-find-a-changed-copy.nvs`) gives hashes that separate clearly; a flat canvas does not.

**`QrCode::render`'s proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — at `extensions/image/nvs/QrCode.nvs:9`; `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-QrLevel/01-more-repair-more-modules.nvs` shows how to find the module count.

**The text members' proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — `Image::text`, `Image::measureText` at `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:244` and `Font::fromBytes` at `extensions/image/nvs/Font.nvs:17`; first settle how an example gets font bytes (§ State).

backlog: `bun nv proofs --comments docs/examples/novis tests/hostile/novis benches/members/novis` — check `dossier-novis-image-analysis-carries-plain-comments`, run it once the group is written.
